name: thermal-solar-power-lite
title: Thermal Solar Power (Lite)
author: ZarSasha, MarximusMaximus, CyberWizard2261, Caxx
description: Streamlined fork of the mod "Thermal Solar Power" by MarximusMaximus and others. Lets you build a thermal solar complex that can output either steam directly or just hot water, for fully or partially renewable power production. The mod incorporates a heat loss mechanism, is highly configurable and has been adapted for Space Age.
